name: Portainer CE
tagline: GUI for managing your Docker environment
description: Visual container management: stacks, containers, images, volumes, networks and templates for Docker, Swarm and Kubernetes.
compose:
services:
  portainer:
    image: portainer/portainer-ce:latest
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${{cfg.port}}:9443"
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - ./data:/data
    restart: unless-stopped
